#include <iostream>

#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long b) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = (ans * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k, l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;
    
    vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<long long>(2 * n + 2, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j > 0) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j + 1] * (j + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = k; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = k; j <= n; j++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j] * dp[2 * n - i][j] % MOD * fac[j] % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    long long result = l * ans % MOD * modPow(dp[2 * n][0], MOD - 2) % MOD * modPow(2 * n + 1, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    cout << result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
